content: QBR with CTO and VP Engineering reviews current infrastructure health and AI roadmap. VP Engineering shares plans to onboard 3 new ML teams.
VP Engineering proposes POC for new large-language-model fine-tuning workloads on existing GPU cluster. CSM facilitates architecture review to ensure success.
POC workloads deployed successfully. GPU utilization climbs from 55% to 62%. VP Engineering reports positive results to CTO.
GPU utilization crosses 70% for the first time. Workload Diversity Score increases to 4 distinct workload types. AI platform showing strong adoption.
GPU utilization hits 75% -- the key expansion threshold. Capacity utilization at 78%. Training job completion rate holds strong at 93%. Champion's teams are scaling rapidly.
CSM-led capacity planning session with VP Engineering and Infrastructure Director. Show capacity runway depletes in 10 weeks at current growth rate. Champion agrees to raise expansion budget request.
GPU utilization hits 85%. Training job completion rate drops to 82% as jobs queue for resources. Inference latency (P95) climbs from 40ms to 65ms. First complaints from ML teams.

Critical GPU memory exhaustion incident. Two production inference endpoints go down for 3 hours. Thermal management score degrades as GPUs run at sustained high load. Infrastructure Director raises concerns about reliability.
VP Engineering escalates to CTO: current infrastructure cannot support AI roadmap. Without expansion, 2 planned ML projects will be delayed 6 months. CTO requests expansion proposal within 2 weeks.
CTO approves $5.2M expansion budget. Infrastructure Director begins procurement process. CSM provides detailed sizing recommendation based on workload growth projections.
Technical deep-dive with Infrastructure Director on expansion architecture. CSM arranges reference call with similar customer who expanded successfully. Pricing negotiation begins.
Interim GPU scheduling optimization deployed. Training job completion rate recovers to 88%. Inference latency improves to 52ms. Demonstrates CS team's ability to deliver value under pressure.
Infrastructure Director signs $5.2M expansion purchase order. 128 additional GPUs across 4 new racks. Deployment timeline: 8 weeks to full production.
First 2 expansion racks commissioned and online. GPU utilization drops from 88% to 68% as capacity doubles. Training job queues clear immediately. Performance metrics normalize across the board.

All 4 expansion racks commissioned. Full deployment complete. VP Engineering presents expansion success to board, crediting CS partnership. Account health at 88, expansion probability resets for next cycle.
